text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City hears about her own reputation 
from her friend, Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Gold City will aim for the Triple 
Tiara— among the fans, voices brimming 
with anticipation for her success filled 
the air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, even the manager who had been 
reluctant about her entering races offered 
his support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her expectations, the 
supportive reactions from those around her 
greatly boosted Gold City's morale.
